_lineage.methodology: WU hourly-proxy daily max as ground truth for all 41 cities. Auto unit detection. Forecast + observation converted to each city's MARKET unit (°F for 12 cities, °C for 29) before integer-rounding + equality compare. Matches Polymarket bucket resolution methodology.
_lineage.prior_bug: Pre-v3.99.2 generator forced both sides to Celsius regardless of market unit. For °F markets this produced buckets ~1.8× wider than Polymarket resolution — inflating WR for atlanta, austin, chicago, dallas, denver, houston, los-angeles, miami, nyc, san-francisco, seattle by 7-37pp. v3.99.7 extended the fix to london after a parquet audit showed Polymarket trades London in °F 85% of the time (2253 °F vs 399 °C markets). Phase 02.22 release audit detected both via cross-check against polymarket_asos_ground_truth_v1.
